summary: LQR House Inc. filed an 8-K on October 16, 2026, disclosing the abrupt resignation of CEO Sean Dollinger from all officer, director and affiliate roles effective that same date, plus termination of his March 29, 2023 employment agreement. Settlement consideration comprises a $500,000 lump-sum cash payment within eight days and transfer of all outstanding stock of subsidiary LQR House Acquisition Corp. to a Dollinger-designated entity under a separate stock purchase agreement, with mutual releases, D&O tail coverage for at least six years, and a required Company name change within 90 days. Watch for governance vacuum and cash/asset drain risk.
